classification.difficultyReason: Apply the quadrilateral angle sum to three given angles, including marked right angles and reflex interior angles.

content.prompt: Determine the size of each unknown angle in these quadrilaterals.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral with horizontal top and bottom, vertical right edge, sloping left edge and a right-angle marker at the upper-right vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown label appear.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+110+90+70&=360\\a+270&=360\\a&=90\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $a=90^\circ$.

spec.description: Concave quadrilateral with an inward left vertex, reflex-angle arc opening through the interior on its right, and the 230° label to its left.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles are a°, 37°, 23° and the reflex angle 230°. The reflex angle is used directly in the 360° sum.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown label appear.

answer.worked:
The $230^\circ$ reflex angle is an interior angle. The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+37+23+230&=360\\a+290&=360\\a&=70\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $a=70^\circ$.

spec.description: Concave quadrilateral with a shallow upper edge, a sharp rightmost vertex, a low vertex and an inward vertex bearing the reflex-angle arc.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles are a°, 15°, the reflex angle 250° and 25°. The reflex angle is used directly in the 360° sum.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown label appear.

answer.worked:
The $250^\circ$ reflex angle is an interior angle. The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+15+250+25&=360\\a+290&=360\\a&=70\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $a=70^\circ$.
